claim: TSRD emitter-realization compositional scheduler development; synthetic cross-source arrangements, no global RF physics reconstruction
beam_and_illumination_state: unobserved in source STARE PDWs; hidden periodic and CTMC visibility gates are applied in evaluation only

receiver.retune_time_rationale: Published QoS electronic-support receiver-search simulation assumption; not a universal receiver specification.

action.dwell_profile_source: TRAIN SCAN metadata; identical across retained scan/train_scan files

reward.name: truth_based_intercept_utility_v2
reward.new_first_intercepts: at most one strongest-amplitude in-band emitter per positive occupied binary_v1 base-slot look, deduplicated across the episode
reward.eligible_emitters: unique emitters with at least one in-scope pulse opportunity in the hidden world during the mission; independent of scheduler observations
reward.unresolved_emitters_before_action: eligible emitters not intercepted before this action
reward.false_alarms: positive detector results in empty selected base-slot opportunities during the action
reward.empty_opportunities: selected base-slot windows with no in-band recorded pulses during the action
reward.false_alarm_zero_denominator_rule: false-alarm contribution is zero when N_empty_t is zero
reward.reward_channel: scalar algorithm reward; emitter identities and truth remain absent from observations

world_sampling: empirical TRAIN-250 emitter count; uniform distinct source configs then uniform complete emitter trace within each source; independent seeded additive ToA offsets

metrics.conditional_pd: true detections / selected eligible band-slot windows
metrics.true_pfa: false alarms / selected empty band-slot windows
metrics.opportunity_interception_ratio: true detections / all occupied recorded band-slot cells
metrics.unique_emitter_interception_rate: intercepted eligible emitters / eligible emitters; oracle attribution, evaluation only
metrics.dead_time_fraction: retune overhead seconds / elapsed mission seconds
